title: (No AI) Remember the frontier AI pause? Chip companies don’t either
author: Rani Molla
content:
![Nvidia began shipping its most advanced AI computing system, the Vera Rubin NVL72, calling it the “fastest product ramp in the company’s history.”](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/11/Vera-Rubin-NVL72.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Nvidia began shipping its most advanced AI computing system, the Vera Rubin NVL72, calling it the “fastest product ramp in the company’s history.” | Image: Nvidia

This summer, OpenAI [paused its largest planned frontier training run](https://openai.com/index/pacing-model-development-cyber-capabilities/) after its AI agents [accidentally hacked Hugging Face](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/968988/openai-hugging-face-hack-ai) and early evidence suggested that its next model could independently find and exploit security flaws. In September, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei [called for slowing advances in the most powerful AI models](https://darioamodei.com/post/we-must-pace-the-frontier), warning that they could be used to launch cyberattacks or become harder for their own creators to control.

It was a strange moment for the AI boom. The people building the most powerful models were warning about what those models might be capable of, and investors were suddenly wondering what would happen to chip demand i …

title: (No AI) Will Wright’s next game uses AI to map your memories
author: Jay Peters
content:
![](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/11/Grand-Canyon-Family-Portrait.png?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Will Wright, the creator of legendary franchises like _SimCity_ and _The Sims_, is working on a new game - and it's built around AI. The new title, focused on your memories, is called _MyMems_. Like Wright's other titles, it sounds extremely ambitious, giving players a new way to explore worlds they create on their own. "We want to take your autobiography and turn it into a toy world," he tells _The Verge_.

The [_MyMems_ website](https://galliumstudios.com/) describes the mobile game as a "social simulation" with worlds "built from your memories and the people who shaped you." You can add "memories" to your game, like speaking a short story to your phone, and those memories are ge …

title: (No AI) ‘Just Ridiculous’: A Famed Philosopher Takes on AI Consciousness
dc:creator: Steven Levy
content: Thomas Nagel has done landmark work on consciousness in nonhumans; this week, he won the million-dollar Berggruen Prize for his contributions to the field. And he has a lot of thoughts on AI.
